name: Coconut Water
siboNotes: Well tolerated in SIBO as it's naturally FODMAP-free and provides electrolytes without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Choose pure coconut water without added sugars or fruit juices
Chill before serving for best taste
Check labels to avoid varieties with high FODMAP additives like apple juice
Fresh coconut water from young coconuts is ideal if available
pairsWellWith: low FODMAP smoothies with spinach and banana
post-workout snacks with low FODMAP nuts
tropical fruit salads with kiwi and pineapple
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in potassium for heart health and muscle function
Low in calories compared to fruit juices
